public_rationale: The forecast was that AI agents would be a major focus of attention in the AI field in 2025, and that year has ended. On January 23, 2025, OpenAI launched Operator, a web agent it described as one of its first agents (e1). On July 17, 2025, OpenAI added agent capabilities to ChatGPT (e2). The MIT AI Agent Index, published in February 2026, says 2025 marked a substantial rise in attention to AI agents (e3). It reports that Google Scholar papers mentioning 'AI agent' or 'agentic AI' exceeded the total from all prior years combined. It also reports that 24 of the 30 agents it tracks were released or received major agentic updates in 2024–2025 (e3). On a plain reading, these items meet the support condition. No counterevidence was found.
limitations: 'Major focus' has no numeric threshold. The evidence shows agents were prominent but does not rank them against other themes in the field.
Both launch items come from one company, OpenAI.
Gartner's 2025 Hype Cycle press release could not be read and was not used.
